name: France National Quantum Strategy
description: France's National Quantum Strategy, part of the France 2030 investment plan, allocates €1.8 billion to quantum technology development including €1 billion in public funding. The strategy covers quantum computing, simulators, sensors, post-quantum cryptography, and secure communication, and includes the PROQCIMA programme awarding up to €500 million to five companies building French-designed universal quantum computers by 2030.
